scope: Offline Friday observed-indicator replay and synthetic control verification, not a broker-account or executable-option-PnL backtest.
baseline: Raw cross direction, VWAP-only squeeze filter, 1/2 ATR stop/target, 2 minute cooldown, existing entry/flat schedule.
vwap_veto: Veto CALL if <=20% of available closes in trailing 30 clock minutes are above VWAP, veto PUT if >=80%. Require >=25 observations, otherwise do not veto. Include current snapshot.
stress: Each retained control+entry variant also runs with 1 and 2 clock minutes of additional hypothetical exit delay; reverse within-ticker entry priority at zero delay.
execution: Immediate hypothetical entry at observed underlying close; exit at first available close after trigger/delay, except specified logged failure scenarios. No interpolated missing bars, no fabricated option quotes.
failure_injection: Six logged exit retry bot/minute/side observations applied if a simulated position matches. Successful next attempt is hypothetical; logged entry failures/unknown orders are not asserted filled in factual replay.
range: Fixed opening range bounds reconstructed in existing source table; no original opening OHLC available. Sensitivity +/-0.01 on each boundary is required. This is retrospective initialization, not an independently reconstructed opening range.
monetary_limits: Not evaluable from underlying-only alternative trades. No option cash ledger, daily dollar-loss limit, fee accounting, risk reservations in dollars or broker PnL claim. Production safeguards are untouched.
evaluation: Show all trials, gross underlying signal-ATR averages, counts, total normalized movement, worst trade, open positions and vetoes. Positive single-session results do not establish an edge. No significance claim or fresh holdout.
control_acceptance: No opposing ticker reservation/position in coordinated mode; pending/unknown orders retain ownership until reconciled; late/duplicate/partial fills do not allow premature reversal or excess exits. Synthetic tests separately exercise these cases.
